question:
Four different positions of the same dice are shown, the six faces of which are numbered from 1 to 6. Select the number that will be on the face opposite to the one having '1'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/caaa72d8e71aaa12ba3a28131803924d98ef6d5543d735ae36de0fa45690e421.png]
solution:
For find the opposite face of '1', we need to compare the common surface in the given dices,

Now,

From Dice 1 and Dice 4,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1f4c52dee7ff621beb581b0218f259548598399099fceb562cfbe30c3f19c67d.png] 

Here, 5 and 3 is the common surfaces in the both Dices, and 1 and 2 are opposite sides of the given dice..

So, '2 is the opposite face of 1'. 

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
